items.title: Pete Jolly interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: Well when Jack called that first album, “Jolly Jumps In” that was his title... Well that was Jack again. He wanted all the artists to do a version of “Lullaby of Birdland.”

ctx.x: And then Frank Rosolino was on Stan’s band and Lennie Niehaus and Bill Holman, Jack Montrose, the sax section, and Sam Noto. You ever hear of Sam?
